comment: She is a wonderful professor who is very passionate about the subject. She is very easy to understand and wants her students to do well, but certainly requires effort. I would absolutely recommend this professor.

The subject of this class is not necessarily interesting, however she makes the class as interesting as possible. I haven't had any major assignments graded yet however she gives pop quizzes on the reading and is fairly lenient as long as an effort is demonstrated. She is easy to understand in class and on assignments.
